CustomField.description: Unique Key for connecting Typeform responses to their related Customer Success. Passed to Typeform from URL Parameter. URL Parameter set in form embed in from email template(FlowEmail_TypeformIntegration_CoreOnboardingCSATSurvey) sent in flow (CustomerSuccess_CoreOnboarding_SendSurveyResponseEmail). Used by Flow(SurveyResponse_CreateLookupRelationships) to create Lookup relationship to Case on creation. Hidden to all users expect Admins on page layouts
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Hidden to all users expect Admins. Used in automation to create lookup on Customer Success to Survey Response.
CustomField.label: Customer Success Id
